customisationOptions.option: Pair the flight with the standard West Bank day
customisationOptions.source: The flight is weather-dependent and the schedule is fixed by the sun; we usually pair this with the standard West Bank day so the ground-level visits arrive with the aerial map already in your head.

customisationOptions.option: Give flexible mornings to allow for postponement
customisationOptions.source: If your dates have any slack, tell our concierge which mornings could work and we'll place the flight where a postponement still has somewhere to go.
